purpose: Explain the Buildcamp learning sequence and workload

required_facts.fact: The course teaches AI engineering by building.
Evidently documentation powers the running example.
Week 1 covers LLMs, OpenAI API, RAG and search.
Week 4 adds unit tests and LLM judges.
Week 6 covers systematic evaluation and synthetic data.
Homework introduces several independent agent projects.
The capstone is built from day 1 and refined through week 9.

author_attribution: Explain the course structure as described by its author, retaining its practical limits and workload.
